component.name: ProbeButtonGroup
component.script:
sub init() m.top.layoutDirection = "horiz" m.top.itemSpacings = 18 m.top.buttonFocused = 0 m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onGroupFocusChanged") end sub
sub onGroupFocusChanged() plog(m.top.caseName, "grpFC", "hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.top.isInFocusChain().toStr()) if m.top.hasFocus() button = m.top.getChild(m.top.buttonFocused) if button <> invalid plog(m.top.caseName, "grpForward", "to=" + button.id) button.setFocus(true) end if end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false currentFocus = m.top.buttonFocused currentFocusButton = m.top.getChild(currentFocus) target = -1 if key = "right" for i = currentFocus + 1 to m.top.getChildCount() - 1 b = m.top.getChild(i) if b <> invalid and b.hasField("isEnabled") and b.isEnabled target = i exit for end if end for else if key = "left" for i = currentFocus - 1 to 0 step -1 b = m.top.getChild(i) if b <> invalid and b.hasField("isEnabled") and b.isEnabled target = i exit for end if end for end if if target < 0 then return false plog(m.top.caseName, "key", "key=" + key + " from=" + currentFocus.toStr() + " to=" + target.toStr()) currentFocusButton.setFocus(false) m.top.buttonFocused = target m.top.getChild(target).setFocus(true) m.top.moved = key return true end function
